name: MusicGrabber
description: MusicGrabber is a self-hosted music downloader for grabbing one song or a whole album at a time. It searches YouTube, SoundCloud, Monochrome and Soulseek, files tagged tracks into your library, and keeps it current with watched playlists from nine platforms, watched MusicBrainz artists and automatic quality upgrades.

notes.text: There is no login until a second account exists: anyone who can reach port 8080 has full access. Add accounts under Settings, System, User Management to turn on sign-in.
Downloads go to /opt/musicgrabber_data/music. To use your own library, mount it into the container, set MUSIC_DIR in /opt/musicgrabber_data/.env and restart musicgrabber.
